problemStatement.plain: For finite types with decidable equality, the orbit classification at the heart of Cantor-Bernstein-Schroeder is decidable. We construct a bijection from mutual injections with fully computable orbit classification, answering OQ-04: constructive CBS for specific set classes.

insights: For Fintype types with DecidableEq, orbit classification is decidable
Pigeonhole on bounded monotone N-sequences gives stabilization of Finset iterations
Cross-case contradiction (reachable + non-reachable) uses closure under g∘f
Decomposition lemma (base or g∘f-image) is key for surjectivity
Lean noncomputable tag on bijection is artifact of Multiset quotient, not mathematical limitation
expand_mono + iterate_succ_apply rewriting pattern for Finset iteration proofs
